title: Unsturdy, Unven. Unimpressed.
text:
Unsturdy, Unven. Unimpressed.. [[VIDEOID:c2a0cf8533eb128ba91397e07a6dc94a]] Easy to assemble, and will work for some organizing needs, but it looks and feels so cheap in person. It is rickety too. Why is it so messed up? It is just two main metal structures with light plastic shelves that get popped into place. Disappointing.

One foot is shorter than the rest. $24 is not chump change when there is a while host of products out there. I would say this is maybe a $10 product. Pack of two? Maybe I would overlook the rocking back and forth if I were using it in a secure but not seen location.

I had plans for it and hoped to get greater use out of it. I can't handle the rocking back and forth every time I touch the shelving unit. I could but shouldn't have to slip a wedge under it. So, it just sits empty until I decide further.

10"W x 6.7"D x 17"H
